# CASE 16

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
install.packages("mclust")
```

# TRAIN
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(mclust)

# TRAIN DATA

lines <- readLines("~/Desktop/supermarket case/supermarket.csv", warn = FALSE)

supermarket_raw <- tibble(
  transaction_id = 1:length(lines),
  basket = lines
)

dept_map <- c(
  "1" = "Bakery & Pastry",
  "2" = "Beer & Wine",
  "3" = "Books & Magazines",
  "4" = "Candy & Chips",
  "5" = "Care & Hygiene",
  "6" = "Cereals & Spreads",
  "7" = "Cheese & Tapas",
  "8" = "Dairy & Eggs",
  "9" = "Freezer",
  "10" = "Fruit & Vegetables",
  "11" = "Household & Pet",
  "12" = "Meat & Fish",
  "13" = "Pasta & Rice",
  "14" = "Salads & Meals",
  "15" = "Sauces & Spices",
  "16" = "Soda & Juices",
  "17" = "Special Diet",
  "18" = "Vegetarian & Vegan"
)

long_data <- supermarket_raw %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  mutate(basket = str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price),
    !is.na(department_name),
    time >= 0,
    price >= 0
  )

basket_data <- long_data %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_time = sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_time_per_item = mean(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_time_per_item = sd(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    price_per_second = ifelse(total_time > 0, total_price / total_time, NA_real_),
    max_price = max(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_price_share = ifelse(total_price > 0, max(price, na.rm = TRUE) / total_price, NA_real_),
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sd_time_per_item = replace_na(sd_time_per_item, median(sd_time_per_item, na.rm = TRUE)),
    price_per_second = replace_na(price_per_second, median(price_per_second, na.rm = TRUE)),
    max_price_share = replace_na(max_price_share, median(max_price_share, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

# COMPACT FEATURE SET FOR GMM

gmm_train <- basket_data %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    total_items,
    total_price,
    avg_price,
    total_time,
    avg_time_per_item,
    sd_time_per_item,
    price_per_second,
    max_price,
    max_price_share,
    unique_departments
  )

X_gmm_raw <- gmm_train %>%
  select(-transaction_id)

X_gmm <- scale(X_gmm_raw)

# FIT GMM

set.seed(123)

gmm_model <- Mclust(
  data = X_gmm,
  G = 1:8
)

# density-based anomaly score:
# lower density = more suspicious
train_density <- dens(
  data = X_gmm,
  modelName = gmm_model$modelName,
  parameters = gmm_model$parameters
)

gmm_train$gmm_density <- train_density
gmm_train$gmm_score <- -log(train_density)

train_pred <- predict(gmm_model, newdata = X_gmm)

gmm_train$cluster_id <- as.integer(train_pred$classification)
gmm_train$cluster_uncertainty <- 1 - apply(train_pred$z, 1, max)

basket_gmm_train <- basket_data %>%
  left_join(
    gmm_train %>%
      select(transaction_id, gmm_density, gmm_score, cluster_id, cluster_uncertainty),
    by = "transaction_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    gmm_score_01 = percent_rank(gmm_score)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(gmm_score))

top_150_gmm_train <- basket_gmm_train %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

summary(top_150_gmm_train$total_items)
summary(top_150_gmm_train$total_price)
summary(top_150_gmm_train$avg_time_per_item)
summary(top_150_gmm_train$gmm_score)
summary(top_150_gmm_train$cluster_uncertainty)

write.csv(
  top_150_gmm_train,
  "~/Desktop/top_150_gmm_train.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

# CASE16: PURE GMM DENSITY TEST

```{r}
case16_lines <- readLines("~/Desktop/case16.csv", warn = FALSE)

case16_raw <- tibble(
  raw_line = case16_lines
) %>%
  mutate(
    transaction_id = stringr::str_extract(raw_line, "(?<=Transaction\\s)\\d+"),
    transaction_id = as.integer(transaction_id),
    basket = stringr::str_remove(raw_line, "^Transaction\\s+\\d+:")
  )

case16_long <- case16_raw %>%
  select(transaction_id, basket) %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  mutate(basket = stringr::str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price),
    department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price),
    !is.na(department_name),
    time >= 0,
    price >= 0
  )

case16_basket <- case16_long %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_time = sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_time_per_item = mean(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_time_per_item = sd(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    price_per_second = ifelse(total_time > 0, total_price / total_time, NA_real_),
    max_price = max(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_price_share = ifelse(total_price > 0, max(price, na.rm = TRUE) / total_price, NA_real_),
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sd_time_per_item = replace_na(sd_time_per_item, median(gmm_train$sd_time_per_item, na.rm = TRUE)),
    price_per_second = replace_na(price_per_second, median(gmm_train$price_per_second, na.rm = TRUE)),
    max_price_share = replace_na(max_price_share, median(gmm_train$max_price_share, na.rm = TRUE))
  )

gmm_case16 <- case16_basket %>%
  select(
    transaction_id,
    total_items,
    total_price,
    avg_price,
    total_time,
    avg_time_per_item,
    sd_time_per_item,
    price_per_second,
    max_price,
    max_price_share,
    unique_departments
  )

X_case16_raw <- gmm_case16 %>%
  select(-transaction_id)

X_case16 <- scale(
  X_case16_raw,
  center = attr(X_gmm, "scaled:center"),
  scale = attr(X_gmm, "scaled:scale")
)

case16_density <- dens(
  data = X_case16,
  modelName = gmm_model$modelName,
  parameters = gmm_model$parameters
)

case16_pred <- predict(gmm_model, newdata = X_case16)

gmm_case16$gmm_density <- case16_density
gmm_case16$gmm_score <- -log(case16_density)
gmm_case16$cluster_id <- as.integer(case16_pred$classification)
gmm_case16$cluster_uncertainty <- 1 - apply(case16_pred$z, 1, max)

case16_gmm <- case16_basket %>%
  left_join(
    gmm_case16 %>%
      select(transaction_id, gmm_density, gmm_score, cluster_id, cluster_uncertainty),
    by = "transaction_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    gmm_score_01 = percent_rank(gmm_score)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(gmm_score))

top_150_gmm_case16 <- case16_gmm %>%
  slice_head(n = 150)

summary(top_150_gmm_case16$total_items)
summary(top_150_gmm_case16$total_price)
summary(top_150_gmm_case16$avg_time_per_item)
summary(top_150_gmm_case16$gmm_score)
summary(top_150_gmm_case16$cluster_uncertainty)

writeLines(as.character(top_150_gmm_case16$transaction_id))

write.csv(
  top_150_gmm_case16,
  "~/Desktop/top_150_gmm_case16.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
